stem: Which pairing of cannabis organ and primary function is most accurate?
choices: Leaf — major photosynthetic surface; root — water and mineral uptake interface
Root — primary pollen-producing organ; leaf — seed enclosure
Stem — seed coat formation; root — light interception
Flower — root-zone absorption; leaf — anchorage in the substrate
rationale: Leaves are major photosynthetic organs, while roots anchor the plant and provide the main interface for water and mineral-nutrient uptake.
